subject.title: fix(qa-lab): reject hex/exponent Telegram SUT uid env values

question: Should Telegram QA SUT UID, GID, and cleanup-timeout environment values intentionally become decimal-only, rejecting hex and exponent strings that current launchers may rely on?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but it narrows an operator-facing environment contract; repository policy treats stricter validation and new startup failures as compatibility-sensitive choices requiring affected-area ownership.

options.title: Adopt decimal-only parsing
options.body: Accept the startup break for non-decimal launcher values and merge the shared strict-parser implementation.

options.title: Preserve coercion compatibility
options.body: Retain the currently accepted forms or define an explicit compatibility path before changing the default.

recommendation.title: Adopt decimal-only parsing
recommendation.body: Accept the startup break for non-decimal launcher values and merge the shared strict-parser implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the Telegram QA lane and are the strongest history-backed owner for its launcher contract.
